Japan’s Yakuza once known for power, tattoos, and strict codes  is now on the verge of disappearing. The NEW generation the Gen Z in Japan sees no value in old-school gang culture. With less than 10,000 aging members left, the Yakuza is a shadow of its past. Tough laws, digital payments, and modern values have pushed the youth away from the well know Japanese Gang Culture.
